verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no first-party way to restrict which apps, surfaces, or accounts Sai may touch, such as an allowlist, denylist, or account scoping. Approval prompts before sensitive steps and running on dedicated cloud computers are adjacent controls, not enforced scope limits. The docs instead stress that Sai works across the entire operating system (desktop apps, browsers, file systems, terminals), with logins persisting between sessions.
